text: The world is not collapsing. It is being squeezed from every direction. Five pressures. One planet.
First: heat. Extreme weather is showing up in food, power, health, and insurance costs.
Second: displacement. More than one hundred twenty million people were forced from home by the end of twenty twenty-four.
Third: debt. The IMF warned public debt could top a hundred trillion dollars. Interest crowds out the future.
Fourth: AI. The race needs chips, water, power—and a bigger grid.
Fifth: military spending hit two point seven trillion dollars in twenty twenty-four. A record is not stability.
These are not five separate crises. They feed one another. Heat raises costs. Debt narrows choices.
AI strains the grid. Fear drives spending. Who gets to write the rules that come next?
